name: builder-kit
description: The Jiffi build workflow as an installable kit — take a raw idea to a shipped, well-built product and keep iterating on it: verify setup, scaffold, idea -> PRD -> ADRs -> plan, the phase-by-phase build loop with real gates, test & verify, CI/CD, ship, ops, and add-a-feature-to-a-live-product. Replaces the copy-paste guides; the guides teach the why.
